title: Activities
help.page:
Every activity: search and filter above, click a column title to sort.
"Edit" changes one activity's name, type, effort, pain, pack, tags, terrain or exclusion; the chart icon opens it in Charts.
The "Achievements" tab: your trail runs and hikes, the Baiyue (Taiwan's 100 Peaks) summited, and a list to copy for a hiking group.
Only the app's own data changes; the original FIT files are never modified.
help.editor:
Automatic values are marked "Auto" (hover for the reason); values you set are marked "Manual" — pick "Auto" or clear the field to go back. Changes save at once.
Only the app's own data changes; the original FIT files are never modified.
help.name: Leave empty or press "Restore" to use the original name (the source file's title; without one: date + sport + distance).
help.effort:
Order: your mark > the RPE the watch recorded (post-workout rating, FIT workout_rpe; only Garmin watches write it) > the COROS post-run rating > the heart-rate rule.
The COROS post-run rating (only after a workout run from the COROS calendar) maps to RPE: Very Light→2, Light→4, Moderate→5, Hard→7, Max Effort→10 (estimate: COROS publishes no conversion).
RPE mapping (estimate): 1–4 easy, 5–8 moderate, 9–10 max (hard with rests when long rests > 10%).
The HR rule looks at moving HR as a share of LTHR, time above AeT and long rests.
help.pain:
Did it hurt? "Sore" is normal post-training soreness, not an injury; "Pain" changes your form or pace, or still hurts afterwards; "Stopped" means you had to stop.
"Pain" or "Stopped" opens an Injury log entry; add the details on the Injury log page.
Blank is not "No pain": the analysis only trusts "No pain".
This is not a diagnosis; see a doctor or physiotherapist for lasting pain.
help.pack: Pack carried (kg), used by the Taiwan's 100 Peaks (Baiyue) prediction; blank = not recorded.
help.tags: Free text, several allowed (30 characters each, up to 20); press Enter after each. The search above finds tags too.
help.terrain: Road or trail. Auto = by distance and climb; choosing road / trail overrides the rule, "Auto" restores it. With the WKO5 source the terrain is the WKO5 workout type; change it in WKO5.
help.exclude: Excluding is only a flag: the activity stays in the list (marked "Excluded") and its file is not deleted, but it no longer counts in the PMC, power curves, race power or charts. A rule excludes likely vehicle rides or impossible power; you can exclude by hand or mark a rule-excluded one as normal.
help.power: Read only. Stryd power is always used; watch-estimated power only when turned on in Settings — otherwise the power model and power TSS ignore it, HR and pace are used as usual.
col.name: Name
src_fill: (the primary source lacks it, so this source fills in)
auto_failed: Auto type / effort could not be computed; reload later
ex.keep: This one is fine, don't exclude
ex.confirm: Exclude this activity? It stays in the list (marked "Excluded") and its file is not deleted, but it no longer counts in the PMC, power curves, race power or charts. You can undo it here.
tab.label: View
help.f_ach: Only trail runs and hikes (the records of the "Achievements" tab). Badges by the name: ▲ the Baiyue peaks summited; Mid-mountain and Baiyue grade the highest point.
ach.help:
One record per trail run or hike, graded by its highest point: Baiyue (Taiwan's 100 Peaks class) ≥ 3000 m, Mid-mountain 1500–3000 m, Low hill < 1500 m.
Click a name to rename it; ×N is how often you did the same route — click it to name the route.
Shang-He ratio = moving time ÷ the Shang-He map's standard time (enter minutes). ✕ hide = leave it out of the hiking-group list.
The search and dates above apply here too. Edits stay in the app; the original records are never modified.
ach.copied: Copied to the clipboard; you can edit it here and copy again
ach.copy_manual: Couldn't copy automatically; select the text below and copy it
ach.col.name: Name
ach.help_vam: Climbing speed of the biggest climb (moving time only).
ach.help_sh: Moving time ÷ the Shang-He map's standard time. 1.0 = exactly the map time; lower is faster.
ach.computing: Building achievements… (the first time reads every trail run and hike; fast after that)
ach.none: No trail runs or hikes yet
ach.rep_tip: Same route done {n} times; click to name the route
ach.hide: Hide (leave out of the hiking-group list)
ach.route_prompt: Name this route (applies every time you do it; empty = remove):
help.race: Lists only the runs you marked as a race. Tap “Race” in the list to mark a past race (tap again to undo); the race prediction is checked against the actual results of these races. The app never guesses which run was a race.
race.on_tip: Mark as a race: the race prediction is checked against this result
race.off_tip: You marked this as a race; tap again to undo
